how: h2/h3 headings of each system's page, fetched 2026-10-27 (Carbon and Atlassian as HTML, Apple HIG as its JSON document); one topic per idea, merged across systems

topics.topic: Colour anatomy: the palette families (saturated, neutral, alpha) and how they relate

Colour roles and emphasis levels, including inverse colour on bold fills
Colour tokens: naming, core versus component tokens, applying colour through tokens
Interaction states in colour: hover, active, selected, focus, disabled
Colour in light and dark themes and the global background colours
High contrast moments and increased-contrast modes
Contrast ratios and never using colour alone to carry meaning
Specifications: the actual values of every system colour
Colour on translucent materials (Liquid Glass colour)
Colour management: colour spaces such as sRGB and Display P3
